title: Free video clip - Sunset through Palm Tree
creator: Johann Mynhardt
credit: "Free video clip - Sunset through Palm Tree" by Johann Mynhardt, CC BY 2.0, via Wikimedia Commons (trimmed, looped)
changes: Cut to 0–15 s of the source (whole clip), last 1–1.5 s cross-faded into the start for a seamless loop (13.52 s); audio removed; scaled to 1280 and 720 px wide; re-encoded as H.264 MP4 and VP9 WebM; poster = first frame of the loop at 1600 px. No colour changes. 2026-10-18: added a 1920 px version (H.264 crf 28, 2.8 MB; VP9 crf 39, 2.4 MB) from the same 1920×1080 source and the same loop, served to screens ≥ 1200 px wide or ≥ 768 px at DPR > 1.5; poster 1920 webp (150 KB).

alsoUsedIn.changes: Social card 1200x630 (imagery pass 2026-10-17): the 1600 poster frame cropped (object-position 62% 55%) under a drawn yellow fascia, the Una Mattina wordmark, an apricot/cream awning and a cream text board. No colour change to the frame. Credit for the frame stays on the site (hero credit line).
